name: Wadsworth
bio: Wadsworth had a ranch on the Little Missouri, was among the stockmen who requested the December 1884 meeting of Little Missouri cattlemen, and held a beef round-up in September 1885. In October 1885 the paper discussed a branding case in which he sought to clear himself of suspicion, and in August 1886 he was named to a stockgrowers' committee on round-ups and line-riding east of the Bad Lands.
